title: 管内点検カメラリール
description: 配管点検や施設保守のシーン用の携帯カメラリール。開いた巻枠、連続した固定ケーブル、持ち手、背面バッテリー外装付き表示器、信号線とレンズ面のある保管状態のプローブを造形。画面とレンズは不透明・非発光で、映像・照明・ケーブル展開や防水性能は含みません。現物の点検装置設計ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.455 × 0.766 × 0.515 m、15,544三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A portable inspection-camera reel for pipe-survey and facility-maintenance scenes, with an open cage, continuous fixed coil, carrying handle, monitor with rear battery exterior, signal lead and parked lens-bearing probe. Display and optics are opaque and nonemissive; video, lighting, cable deployment and waterproof performance are not included. This is not a real inspection-device design. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.455 × 0.766 × 0.515 m; 15,544 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
